title: Google quietly rolled out a new program to let verified political campaigns more easily bypass Gmail's spam filter, after years of complaints from the GOP (Shane Goldmacher/New York Times)
summary: Shane Goldmacher / New York Times: Google quietly rolled out a new program to let verified political campaigns more easily bypass Gmail's spam filter, after years of complaints from the GOP — Republicans previously sued Google claiming its spam filter was biased, but the case was dismissed.
